g.text: John Mayer Sets Up His Own Label, Sob Rock Records, in Partnership With Mercury to Release First New Solo Music in Five Years ◆ ‘Wildwood’ Director Travis Knight on AI: ‘An Amazing Piece of Technology’ But ‘I’m Not Embracing It at All’ ◆ Laika’s First PG-13 Film, Brad Bird’s Neo-Noir and an Alzheimer’s Memoir: Animation’s Revolution Isn’t for Kids ◆ Chaka Khan to Be Honored at Soul Train Awards (TV News Roundup) ◆ ‘Line of Fire’ Gets Full 18-Episode Season Order at NBC ◆ The ‘Terrifier’ Trilogy Is Returning to Theaters for a Halloween Run ◆
